name: workspace.markOpened
title: Mark workspace as opened
summary: Marks the workspace the command runs on as opened now: the absolute path of its main repository goes first in the list of recent workspaces that `workspace.recent` gives. The list keeps the 20 workspaces marked last and belongs to the user, not to a workspace.
details: Two spellings of the same folder (another case on Windows, a symbolic link) are one entry: the entry of that folder goes, and the path as marked now stands first. With 20 entries, the entry marked longest ago goes. A missing list is created with this one entry. When the list cannot be read, holds no list of ReqSeq, cannot be written, or another process is writing it, the command refuses, names the reason and changes nothing; it also refuses when the list would lie inside a repository of the workspace. No other command changes the list.
whileReadOnlyReason: It writes only the user's list of recent workspaces, no file of the workspace, and a read-only workspace can be opened too.

root.title: Workspace root
root.description: The absolute path of the main repository of the workspace (the folder that holds reqseq-workspace.yaml), as the list holds it now, first.

opened.title: Opened
opened.description: When it was marked, as `workspace.recent` gives it.
